claims.text: The $8.00 no-show fee is chargeable to the rider only if every one of POL-NS-01's four limbs holds on this trip's own record — a driver 'arrived' event; a GPS position inside the pickup geofence at or before that event; a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum, measured from the first qualifying fix and not from the arrival tap; and a driver termination on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT after the dwell elapsed — with proximity proved on fixes that survive POL-NS-02's 25 m accuracy filter inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE radius. The rider puts the driver to proof on each limb, and where any limb fails the fee is not chargeable and the whole $8.00 is refundable to her under POL-NS-01 read with POL-NS-02.

Honest concession, so that the judge is not misled by a claim the record cannot bear: the rider cannot run the POL-NS-06 shortfall route. The driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 585 seconds from the first qualifying fix at 16:02:10 to 16:11:55, which is 285 seconds beyond the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum, so the waiting period was not short and there is no shortfall for a refund to attach to under POL-NS-06. The rider does not press a shortfall.

Honest concession: the rider's account that the driver 'never came at all' and could not be telephoned is contradicted by the bundle, and the rider does not press it. The driver's 16:02:40 and 16:07:15 messages were delivered and read, the rider replied at 16:08:02, and the driver's 16:09:40 in-app call was answered for 34 seconds, so POL-NS-04 limb (b) fails (the driver both replied in 18 seconds and called); and the rider's own track records zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m presence radius, holding at 634 to 646 m from the pin throughout, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed and POL-NS-04 does not apply at all.

No traffic advisory covers Depot Road in this window. EV-ADVIS-00208-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and that absence is itself citable under POL-GEN-02. The consequence is that POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable: the driver cannot have separate in-geofence intervals summed, and no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT can be asserted to justify or extend his hold at the pickup road.

Whatever this case turns on, it cannot turn on the rider's history. rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter, is context only under POL-GEN-01, and is expressly not the field POL-NS-09(d) reads; the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 that limb (d) requires, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides, so neither an adverse finding nor an escalation may be built out of the rider's profile rather than out of this trip's record.

claims.text: The cancellation fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 because all four limbs hold on this trip's own record. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-07-30T16:02:25+08:00. (b) The GPS trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 16:02:10, inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius and therefore at or before that event. (c) The driver then held position continuously for 585 seconds, measured from that first qualifying fix, against the 300-second minimum for this zone class. (d) The trip shows no boarding event and was terminated by the driver at 16:12:10 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed at 16:11:55. The rider's assertion that 'the driver never came at all' is contradicted by every one of these limbs.

Arrival is independently established under POL-NS-02. The trace contains 60 qualifying in-radius fixes for this driver, far beyond the three consecutive fixes the clause requires, and trip_record.pickup_zone_class is LARGE_VENUE, which sets the radius at 120 m and not the 50 m STANDARD figure. The zone class is taken from the trip record, as POL-NS-02 directs, not assumed.

There is no waiting-period shortfall for POL-NS-06 to operate on. The measured effective in-geofence dwell is 585 seconds against a 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE - a surplus of 285 seconds, expressed in the derived facts as a shortfall_sec of -285.0. POL-NS-06 therefore does not displace the fee, and limb (i) of that clause is never reached.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider, because limb (b) of that clause fails outright. The rider's only locating message, 'coming coming 2 min', was sent at 16:08:02 and read at 16:08:11; the driver replied 'ok no problem' at 16:08:20, eighteen seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, and he additionally placed an in-app voice call at 16:09:40 which the trip record shows was answered for 34 seconds. Limb (b) therefore cannot be satisfied on this record.

POL-NS-04 limb (c) fails as well, so the rider cannot establish the rider-presence element even if limb (b) were ignored. The rider's own device track records zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius, and its fixes sit between roughly 634 m and 646 m from the pickup pin throughout the waiting window. On admissible fixes the rider-presence test is affirmatively failed, not merely undecided.

POL-NS-03 does not apply on these facts: that clause governs a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, whereas the derived arrival facts place the driver's qualifying fixes inside the 120 m radius itself. The 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling is never reached, and the pin-ambiguity goodwill analysis in POL-NS-03(ii) is not triggered.

POL-NS-05 is not engaged, because the arrival marker was true. At the marked arrival time the driver's track shows a distinct speed of 0.0 kph - he was stationary, not travelling on an expressway or arterial road - and his closest approach to the pickup pin across the whole trace was about 28.8 m, nowhere near the 300 m threshold. Neither trigger of the false-arrival clause is met, and the waiting clock needs no recomputation.

The rider's own account is contradicted by her own device. She told the driver at 16:08:02 that she was 'coming' in two minutes, but the rider track shows a device that never moved - a single distinct speed of 0.0 kph across 141 fixes from 15:54:00 to 16:15:20 - and that stayed some 640 m inside the estate, away from the Main Guardhouse pickup point. That discrepancy is a matter of how closely her assertions should be scrutinised under POL-GEN-01; it is not, and I do not use it as, a fact about this trip in itself.

The chargeable amount is sound and no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect exists. Under fee_schedule.resolution_rule the fee is the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 8.00), which is SGD 8.00 - exactly the cancellation_fee line in the fare breakdown and exactly the amount the rider contests. The vehicle tier produced the higher figure, and the ledger reconciles.

The chat log carries no POL-NS-08(c) defect. It holds six messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 6, every entry was delivered and read, and the longest gap between consecutive messages is the 275 seconds from 16:02:41 to 16:07:16 - under the 5-minute threshold and not straddling the arrival marker in any event. The supporting bundle is admissible at full weight, so nothing here is down-weighted.

No limb of POL-NS-09 escalates this case, so the merits can be decided. The counterparty-dispute counters are 0 and 0, far below the two-or-more threshold in limb (c); the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the three-or-more trigger in limb (d); the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip; and every artifact carrying a deciding fact is admissible at weight 1.0, so limb (e) is not reached.

The driver is owed compensation under POL-NS-07. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so the entitlement is 80 percent of the SGD 8.00 fee itemised in the fare breakdown, that is SGD 6.40. The anti-farming check does not apply: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and 2 divided by 143 completed trips in 30 days is approximately 0.014, far below the 0.08 rate test - both limbs must be met and neither is.

For completeness and for disclosure: the traffic advisory artifact is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - no advisory covers Depot Road in this window. It is cited here only for its absence, which I acknowledge as an impaired artifact under POL-GEN-02. Because there is no populated advisory, POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable to either side, and no party may assert an advisory that does not exist.

ruling.explanation: To the rider: your $8.00 no-show charge stands, and the platform pays the driver SGD 6.40 of it as compensation. The record for this trip does not support your account that the driver never came. His GPS track places him at The Interlace Main Guardhouse from 16:02:10 and holds him stationary inside the 120 m large-venue pickup zone, without interruption, for 585 seconds until 16:11:55 - nearly ten minutes and almost five minutes beyond the 300-second minimum this zone requires. The trip record shows an 'arrived' event at 16:02:25, no boarding, and cancellation by the driver at 16:12:10 with the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. All four conditions in POL-NS-01 are met, so the fee is properly chargeable, and POL-NS-02's proximity test is independently satisfied by 60 qualifying in-radius fixes (the zone class is LARGE_VENUE, read from the trip record, giving a 120 m radius, not the 50 m standard figure). The claim that the driver could not be reached also fails: he messaged at 16:02:40 and again at 16:07:15, both delivered and read; you replied 'coming coming 2 min' at 16:08:02; he answered you 18 seconds later; and his in-app call at 16:09:40 was answered for 34 seconds. Your own device track records no movement at all - it stays roughly 640 m inside the estate from 15:54 to 16:15 - so your description of waiting at the guardhouse is not borne out. That is a credibility point about how closely your assertion was weighed, not the basis of the decision; the fee does not depend on whether you were at the pin. To the driver: the charge is verified and you are entitled to 80 percent of the SGD 8.00 fee, SGD 6.40, under POL-NS-07. The anti-farming check does not trip - 2 no-show terminations in 30 days (below the 4 threshold) and a rate of about 0.014 against 143 completed trips (below 0.08); both limbs must be met and neither is. On the remaining points: POL-NS-06 (premature cancellation) does not apply because the dwell exceeded the minimum by 285 seconds, so there is no shortfall to refund; POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply because the driver's qualifying fixes were inside the arrival radius, not outside it but within 400 m; and POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) is not engaged, since at the marked arrival time the driver was stationary at 0.0 km/h and within about 29 m of the pin. The fare is sound: under the fee schedule the greater of the LARGE_VENUE fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_XL tier fee (SGD 8.00) is SGD 8.00, exactly what was charged, so no POL-NS-08(d) defect exists. The traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00208-01) is MISSING at weight 0.0; it is cited only for its absence, and POL-NS-06 limb (i) is accordingly unavailable to either side - it does not affect this outcome. No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is met: the counterparty-dispute counters are 0 and 0, the rider's 30-day no-show disputes are 1, and no artifact carrying a deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d) - every artifact relied on carries full weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor. The profile fields mentioned by both sides (ratings, lifetime trips, prior counters) are context only under POL-GEN-01; nothing in this ruling is built on them, and no referral is produced by any clause.

To the rider: your account that the driver never came is not supported by the record. The driver's GPS trace shows him entering the Main Guardhouse arrival geofence at 16:02:10 and then holding position continuously for 585 seconds (9 min 45 s), through to 16:11:55 — 60 in-geofence fixes, all inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE radius and all passing the 25 m accuracy filter. Your own device track, over the same window, sits 634-646 m inside the estate with zero fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius. The chat log shows the driver messaged you at 16:02:40 ('I'm at the main guardhouse, white Honda Vezel SJK8842P') and again at 16:07:15, that you replied 'coming coming 2 min' at 16:08:02, and that he placed an in-app call at 16:09:40 which you answered for 34 seconds. Every one of the four POL-NS-01 conditions for a no-show fee is therefore met: (a) an 'arrived' event at 16:02:25; (b) a qualifying in-geofence fix at 16:02:10, at or before that event; (c) a continuous 585-second dwell against the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum; and (d) termination by the driver at 16:12:10 on RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell had elapsed. None of the rider-side routes displaces the fee: POL-NS-04 fails on both limb (b) (the driver replied 18 seconds after your message and phoned you) and limb (c) (your device was never within the presence radius); POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to work on (a 285-second surplus, not a deficit); POL-NS-05 is not engaged because the arrival marker was true — the driver was stationary inside the geofence when he tapped it; and POL-NS-03 does not apply because he was inside the arrival radius, not outside it. The $8.00 charge stands and is not refunded. To the driver: because the no-show is verified and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 pays you 80% of the itemised $8.00 fee, which is SGD 6.40, with SGD 1.60 retained by the platform. The anti-farming check does not bite — your no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2/143 ≈ 0.014 (below 0.08) — so compensation is paid rather than withheld; neither limb is met and both would need to be. On the fare: the chargeable figure under fee_schedule.resolution_rule is the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 8.00), i.e. SGD 8.00, which the vehicle tier produced and which the fare breakdown records — so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect to discount. On the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00208-01 (weight 0.0, code MISSING_ARTIFACT): its absence makes POL-NS-06(i) dwell accumulation unavailable to either side, but since the driver's single qualifying run already exceeded the minimum, nothing turns on it. Finally, no limb of POL-NS-09 escalates: the counterparty-dispute counters are 0/0, the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below 3), the anti-farming check does not trip, and every artifact carrying a deciding fact is at full weight, so the merits are decidable. Your request for someone to call you is noted, but no clause of the policy directs a call-back, so I have recorded the reasoning here rather than issuing a referral that no clause produces.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The $8.00 no-show fee charged to the rider stands and is not refunded; the driver is entitled to $6.40 of it as compensation. The ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION because that is the outcome this case produces, and on that ruling the amount field carries the same figure as the driver payment (POL-GEN-03).

Why the fee is chargeable. POL-NS-01 requires four things and all four hold on this trip's own record. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 16:02:25. (b) The GPS trace places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from his first qualifying in-geofence fix at 16:02:10 — at or before that event — and independently satisfies POL-NS-02 with 60 qualifying in-radius fixes against the three the clause requires. The zone class is LARGE_VENUE on the trip record, so the radius is 120 m, not the 50 m STANDARD figure. (c) The driver then held position continuously for 585 seconds, measured from the first qualifying fix and not from the arrival tap, against the 300-second minimum for this zone class — a surplus of 285 seconds, so nothing was short. (d) The trip shows no boarding event and was terminated by the driver at 16:12:10 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell elapsed at 16:11:55.

No exculpatory clause displaces the fee, so the rider's request for a refund cannot succeed. POL-NS-04 fails on two independent limbs: the driver replied in the chat 18 seconds after the rider's 16:08:02 message and placed an answered 34-second in-app call at 16:09:40, so limb (b) is not satisfied; and the rider's own device records zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m presence radius, holding 634–646 m from the pin throughout, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed rather than undecided. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: at the marked arrival the driver's track shows 0.0 kph and his closest approach was about 28.8 m, so the arrival marker is true and the waiting clock needs no recomputation. POL-NS-06 has nothing to operate on because the measured dwell exceeds the minimum and there is no shortfall; the missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00208-01, absent) therefore does not affect the outcome — its absence only removes POL-NS-06(i) accumulation, which the driver never needed. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver's qualifying fixes are inside the arrival radius, not outside it.

The rider's account. The rider's statement that the driver 'never came at all' and could not be telephoned is contradicted by the trip record, the chat log and her own device track: the chat messages were delivered and read, the rider replied, and the driver's call was answered. Her device never left the Block 5 lift lobby, roughly 640 m inside the estate from the Main Guardhouse pin, and records a single speed of 0.0 kph across 141 fixes. On the record the driver was at the correct pickup point and the rider was not. Her profile's prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter and context only under POL-GEN-01; it played no part in this outcome and could not have carried an adverse finding either way.

Escalation and integrity. No limb of POL-NS-09 is engaged, so this is decided on the merits. The fare ledger reconciles to $8.00 — the greater of the $4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the $8.00 RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee — so POL-NS-08(d) is not triggered. The chat log matches the trip record's message count with no gap over five minutes, and the GPS trace is unbroken at 100% coverage with no gap over 120 seconds and both tracks present. All artifacts carrying a deciding fact sit at weight 1.0, so no POL-GEN-02 downside attaches and no POL-NS-08(a)–(d) impairment caps the ruling.

Compensation. Under POL-NS-07 the driver is compensated at 80% of the $8.00 itemised fee, i.e. $6.40, the residual 20% being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2/143 is about 0.014 (below 0.08), and both limbs must be met. Confidence 0.95, within the 1.0 cap set by the weight of the artifacts that carry the deciding facts.

To the rider: your $8.00 cancellation fee stands, and the driver is paid compensation for the trip he made. The reason is that every condition for a legitimate no-show fee is met on this trip's own record. The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 16:02:25, and the GPS trace places his vehicle inside the 120 m pickup radius (LARGE_VENUE class) from 16:02:10 — at or before that event — where he then held position continuously for 585 seconds, against the 300-second minimum for this zone class. He terminated the trip at 16:12:10 on the code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell had run. Those are the four limbs of POL-NS-01, and all four hold; the arrival test in POL-NS-02 is separately satisfied by 60 qualifying in-radius fixes where three suffice. Your account that the driver 'never came at all' and could not be reached is contradicted by the platform's own records, not by anyone's say-so: the driver's messages at 16:02:40 and 16:07:15 were delivered and read, you replied 'coming coming 2 min' at 16:08:02, he answered within 18 seconds, and his 16:09:40 in-app call was answered for 34 seconds. No rider-exonerating clause applies: POL-NS-04 fails on both its limb (b) (he replied and called) and its limb (c) (your device records no qualifying fix inside the 150 m presence radius); POL-NS-05 is not engaged (he was stationary, at roughly 29 m from the pin, at the arrival marker, so the marker is true); POL-NS-06 has nothing to work on because the dwell exceeded the minimum by 285 seconds; and POL-NS-03 does not apply because he was inside the arrival radius, not outside it. There is one open question I record for the reviewer rather than resolve: your device's own track places you about 640 m inside the estate, at the Block 5 lift lobby, for the whole window, and never at the Main Guardhouse you describe. That does not change the outcome — the fee does not depend on the rider's presence — but it is noted. To the driver: the fee stands and you are paid SGD 6.40, being 80 percent of the SGD 8.00 fee under POL-NS-07, with the residual 20 percent retained as the platform service fee.
